lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY + heavy (NOT yet runtime-proven). Closes all 3 aimlops-platform writes: POST /v1/aimlops-platform (releaseaimlopsplatformv1), PUT /v1/aimlops-platform/{release_id} (updateaimlopsplatformv1), DELETE /v1/aimlops-platform/{release_id} (deleteaimlopsplatformv1). A 'release' provisions an AI/ML-Ops platform ONTO a SKE cluster — billable, slow, and tied to a real cluster_id, so this lifecycle NEVER actually provisions one. Pattern (mirrors ske-upgrade-write-coverage): soft-capture cluster_id from /v1/aimlops-platform/images or a list, soft-capture release_id from the read-only list against a DELIBERATELY-NONEXISTENT field so the {release_id} placeholder stays LITERAL at runtime -> guaranteed 404, then CALL each write once (optional+grouped+broad expect_status) to record coverage without touching a real platform. Marked heavy:true (gated behind SCP_RUN_HEAVY) as defense in depth even though it creates nothing. No data/api_bodies.json entries exist for aimlops-platform; bodies are best-effort from field semantics (release name, cluster_id, image_id, namespace, resource sizing) and are UNPROVEN. probe-reads exercises the id-bound GETs (getaimlopsplatformv1 + the cluster check/validate GETs) when a real id is present.

steps.name: list-images
steps._note: Response uses $.contents[] wrapper (confirmed live 2026-06-20). image_id field CONFIRMED: 'IMAGE-R=HXHY3ccc9f3TSVtPpPFR' format (not a simple UUID, has '='). base_image: 'sdskubeflow-enterprise:1.9.2' (enterprise) or 'sdskubeflow-mini:1.9.1' (mini). product_type field in images response is 'AMP' (internal type, unrelated to validate-resources product_type param which uses 'enterprise|mini').

steps.name: list-releases
steps._note: release_id captured against a nonexistent field so the placeholder stays literal -> the PUT/DELETE/GET-by-id hit a guaranteed 404 (records coverage, touches no real platform). cluster_id soft-captured if a release exists.

steps.name: release-aimlops-platform
steps._note: BILLABLE platform release — never actually provisioned. CORRECTED offline 2026-07-07 (A-repair-9, same fix as generated__heavy-aimlops.json:release-aimlops-platform): data/api_docs.json model `aimlopsplatformcreatewithk8senginerequest` proves the real body is a 3-key wrapper (required `ai_ml_ops_platform_create_request` with required ai_ml_ops_platform_type/image_id/release_name + optional cluster_id, plus sibling nullable kubernetes_engine_create_request/node_pool_create_request) — the prior flat body (with a bogus top-level `namespace`/`description`, neither of which exist in this model) was UNPROVEN and structurally wrong, though it still 400'd harmlessly here since cluster_id/image_id are placeholder literals anyway (this lifecycle deliberately never provisions). expected 400/422 (placeholder cluster_id/image_id) or 403. Deliberately NOT chained to a delete of a real release.

steps.name: update-aimlops-platform
steps._note: In-place update (updateaimlopsplatformv1) on the literal {release_id} -> 404. Body UNPROVEN (description-only guess).

steps.name: delete-aimlops-platform
steps._note: destructive — only runs under SCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE. Targets the literal {release_id} (no real release) -> expected 404. optional+broad so it records coverage without deleting a real platform.

steps.name: probe-cluster-preconditions
steps._note: Stage A coverage (2026-06-14, fixed 2026-06-20): the 5 cluster-bound precondition GETs (validate-namespaces/validate-resources/check-version + internal nodes/storageclasses) and GET-by-id need a cluster_id/release_id this coverage-only run never has. Supply concrete NONEXISTENT 32-char hex UUIDs (the API enforces '32-letter UUID format' and 400s on shorter or non-hex IDs) -> endpoints return 404 (reached, recorded as soft) without provisioning anything. Also supply required query params: version (for check-version) and product_type (for validate-resources) so probe_reads does not skip those endpoints due to unresolvable required query params. Placed BEFORE probe-reads so genuine captured ids, if ever present, overwrite these.

steps.name: probe-reads
steps._note: Final probe-reads using real captured ids (if any). Also supplies required query params for check-version (version) and validate-resources (product_type=enterprise|mini; KUBEFLOW is INVALID, 400) so probe_reads does not skip those endpoints.
